caption: Historical method comparisons on three fixed cohorts. Left: calibrated class log score on the same labeled v3.0 development identities with optional bands measured. The gain includes the effect of the fixed classifier. Middle: v3.3 development distances conditional on a known giant class. Severe errors are absolute modulus residuals over 1 mag. Right: NGC 288 median and central 68% interval with a held-out scale at 9.03 kpc. The historical SED controls and cluster inference have their own model and sample assumptions. Current DR11 QRF catalog performance is measured elsewhere.
